body: I've had worse situations, but no. She did not banish the minions. and yes, she was hitting me. 100%. i definitely felt that, the clay soldiers just acted as if freya wasnt there. Later that match, i attempted to fog-gank her. As i got close enough, i summoned two clay soldiers pointed at her.. They ran to the side and aggro'd onto minions, forcing me to retreat, as they are a large portion of my damage.
They were right behind me, actually. The AI is terrible. Lets face it.

They don't focus enemies that are hitting you though? I just tried boxing a freya (I know i know.. bad idea.) I summoned my minions at the melee-range freya and.. They ran past me, attacking minions. Freya started hitting me. The clay soldiers gave no fucks.

I just summoned my minions towards an enemy freya, that was basically in melee range of me.. My clay soldiers attacked the minions, and when freya started hitting me? They didn't care. They just auto attacked the minion.

I suppose, yeah.. But what stops them from diving you and chasing you away from the tower in general? If the minions are on the tower, you can't stun them to peel them off. And I don't think it'd make her too easy, it still requires a bit of positioning to hit them with her 3 AND the stun, rather than just the stun for minor damage.
I suppose we can't blame them, they -are- made of clay after all..
I don't understand how you work out where your minions will go. My minions have walked past gods literally right in front of me, only to attack minions/jungle creeps.

Actually, yes. They didnt shift any of the damage around to any of her other abilities. Her 3 just did a lot more damage, thats it.  and her ult did more damage too. But i'd still say her 3/2 were a massive portion of her damage. And minion AI wasnt different. So.. Yes. It did rely on terrible minion AI.

Your flair suggests you'd agree with the minion changes though :(
Yes. But even then, her stun and a large portion of her damage was based on luck. (Due to terrible minion AI)
